sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: While underway, two sampans were spotted alongside the barge. The master raised the general alarm and conducted a search. No perpetrators were found on board.  The crew was not injured. Some scrap metal was stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in SS. The RSN’s MSTF and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident. Information of the incident was shared with the Malaysian authorities.
